p: Gemini 4 Carbon, GPT-6.1 Terra, Mistral Large 4, Genie 4 and Nvidia's Nemotron.
Google's model scores 59 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5, the new top spot. Not yet public. Source: Artificial Analysis, 28 Oct.
50% cheaper than GPT-5.6 Terra. Low-effort error rate fell from 53.6% to 16.7% in OpenAI's own test. Source: Let's Data Science, 26 Oct.
Weights for the 1 trillion-parameter model are on Hugging Face, 52 billion active per task. Aimed at coding and cyber defence. Source: TNW, 29 Oct.
DeepMind's world model holds a scene for up to two minutes, double Genie 3, and generates its own audio. Trusted testers only. Source: Free Press Journal, 28 Oct.
Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe is open-weight, covers 40 languages and handles recordings up to one hour. Commercial use allowed. Source: TNW, 28 Oct.
